image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) on a textured, light-colored ground surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots and patches. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands behind the eyes. Short, stout limbs are visible, particularly the front left and right legs, showing blunt digits. The tail extends towards the upper left, partially out of focus. There is some gibberish text or watermark artifacts in the bottom right corner.

The background blur is consistent with a shallow depth of field, but the transition from the sharp subject to the blurred background is slightly abrupt in some areas, suggesting potential synthetic bokeh.
